title: Kusa da tsabta, tafiya da kyau kuma ku bibiyar ci gaban ku
course_title: Ƙwararrun Tattaunawa don Kasuwanci da Rayuwa

say: Kusa da tsabta, tafiya da kyau, kuma ku bibiyar ci gaban ku.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 4 na Ƙwarewar Tattaunawa don Kasuwanci da Rayuwa.
Tattaunawa masu kyau da yawa sun rabu bayan musafaha, saboda kowane bangare yana tunawa da yarjejeniyar daban. Kun ce an hada da isarwa. Ina tsammanin ma'auni ya kasance saboda wata mai zuwa.
Rufe rijiya yana nufin bayyana yarjejeniyar a sarari, cikakke kuma a rubuce.

panel.heading: Rike yarjejeniyar
items: Ku san lokacin da yarjejeniya ke shirye don rufewa
Sanya kowane maɓalli mai mahimmanci a rubuce
Yi matsi da matsi cikin nutsuwa
Auna ci gaban ku kuma ku yi shirin gaba

say: Za ku kuma koyi abin da za ku yi idan magana ta makale, da yadda za ku tabbatar wa kanku cewa kuna inganta.

panel.heading: Rike yarjejeniyar

say: Lokacin da giɓi ya ƙanƙanta kuma ɗayan ɓangaren yana yin tambayoyi masu amfani, kamar yaushe za ku iya bayarwa, matsa don rufewa. Ka ce, kamar muna kusa. Bari in takaita abin da muka amince.

Sannan duba kowane batu. Wanene ƙungiyoyin, daidai abin da aka kawo, farashi, ajiya da ma'auni tare da kwanan wata, bayarwa, da abin da zai faru idan wani abu ya makara ko kuskure. Bangarorin biyu sun tabbatar.

panel.heading: Abin da kowace yarjejeniya ke bukata

say: Bayan tattaunawar waya, Ronke ya aika da sakon WhatsApp a rana guda. Ta jera kayan: tiers, dadin dandano da ƙira, kamar yadda a cikin hoton da abokin ciniki ya aiko.

card.title: Ronke ya tabbatar da odar kek

say: Naira 250000 gabaɗaya, gami da kaiwa zaure da saitin. Ta kuma bayyana lokacin da aka karɓi canje-canjen ƙira, kuma ba za a iya mayar da kuɗin ajiya ba bayan an sayi kayan.
Ta ƙare: da fatan za a ba da amsa Tabbatar idan wannan daidai ne. Abokin ciniki ya tabbatar kuma ya biya, kuma Ronke ta duba kiredit a cikin app ɗin bankinta kafin ta aika da takardar shaida.

say: Idan kun ji fushi, tsoro ko gaggawa, ko ɗayan ya zama mai tayar da hankali, dakatar. Bar idan kun ji rashin lafiya, kuma ku dawo tare da amintaccen mutum ko ci gaba da saƙo.

panel.heading: Matsar da ke karya ajali
items: Ku huta ku yi magana gobe
panel.rule: Kada ku taɓa yin babban yanke shawara na kuɗi yayin fushi

say: Koyi gane dabarun matsa lamba. Ranar ƙarshe na ƙarya. Dole ne oga na ya yarda, bayan kun riga kun amince. Ko ƙananan abubuwan da aka nema bayan kun yarda.

panel.heading: Abin da suke faɗi, yadda kuke amsawa
left: Farashin ya tashi yau da dare, biya yanzu
right: Ina bukata har gobe don yanke shawara
Tayi na kuma yana buƙatar amincewa ta ƙarshe
Mai farin ciki don ƙara wannan, a farashi

say: Amsa cikin nutsuwa. Na gane, Ina bukata har gobe. Sannan tayin shima ya dogara da amincewa ta ƙarshe. Mai farin ciki don ƙara wannan, kuma zai kashe wannan fiye da haka.

panel.heading: Abin da suke faɗi, yadda kuke amsawa
left: Farashin ya tashi yau da dare, biya yanzu
right: Ina bukata har gobe don yanke shawara
Tayi na kuma yana buƙatar amincewa ta ƙarshe
Mai farin ciki don ƙara wannan, a farashi

say: Mai gida yana son naira 1800000 na shekara biyu a gaba.
Wani shago guda biyu titin da ya wuce yana biyan 700000 na shekara guda. BATNA dinta kenan. Tafiya zuwa shagon farko shine 850000 a shekara, ana biya kowace shekara.
Ta ba da 800000 na shekara guda, sannan ta yi ƙoƙari ta biya kashi biyu. Ya ce shekara biyu ko ba komai. Biyanshi gaba d'aya zai bata ajiyarta.
Don haka ta rufe cikin ladabi. Na gode yallabai. Ba ya aiki a gare ni yanzu, amma idan wani abu ya canza, don Allah a kira ni.
Ta duba ɗayan shagon, ta tabbatar da mai shi, kuma ta adana 1100000 don kayan aiki da haja. Tafiya yanke shawara ne bisa lambobi, ba gazawa ba.
Ajiye log, layi ɗaya a kowace tattaunawa. Makin ku yana nuna nisa tsakanin tafiyarku da burin ku da kuka sauka. 0% shine tafiyar ku. 100% shine burin ku.
Anan tafiya ya kasance 27000, manufa 33000, kuma sakamakon 32000. Wato 5000 daga cikin 6000, kusan 83%.
Har ila yau ƙididdige dangantakar daga 1 zuwa 5. Sama da shawarwari goma, idan maki ya tashi yayin da dangantaka ta kasance a 4 ko 5, kuna ingantawa a fili.
Don tunawa. Takaita kowane lokaci kuma a tabbatar da shi a rubuce, tare da rasidun kowane biyan kuɗi. Makullewa yana nufin canza hanya, ba da ƙarfi ba.
Kwatanta mafi kyawun tayin tare da BATNA, kuma kuyi tafiya cikin ladabi lokacin da ya fi muni. Kuma shiga da maki tattaunawar ku.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Takaita kowane lokaci kuma sami Tabbatarwa
Kwatanta mafi kyawun tayin da BATNA ɗin ku
Shiga, ci da bita kowane wata

say: Yanzu juzu'in ku. Rubuta tabbaci don yarjejeniya ta gaske, tsara yadda za ku mayar da martani ga matsi, kuma fara rajistan tattaunawar ku tare da shirin kwanaki 90 don tattaunawar ku mai mahimmanci.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan fayil ɗin ku
items: Fara log ɗin ku da shirin kwanaki 90
